resources.string: Covers the screen with a code prompt during the locked hours you set in Bedtime Lock, and on TV Settings if you choose. It only sees which app comes to the front, not what is on screen, and does not read keys.
Enter the code to change Bedtime Lock
Number keys, or Up 2 · Left 4 · OK 5 · Right 6 · Down 8. Back clears.
The two codes were not the same. Choose one again.
Also lock TV Settings at any hour: %1$s
Lock helper is off: turn on Bedtime Lock in Accessibility
Up and Down change the time by 15 minutes; OK when done
Unlocked until the TV goes to standby.
